messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up: ACME wants an "compact image summary" beta by Friday. We need owners for infra/runtime/security and a short risk checklist.
Noah (Eng): Timeline tight but doable if infra + runtime parallelize. Main risks: API contract for images and graceful degrade to text-only.
Priya (Runtime): Runtime needs a tokenization shim for image embeddings and a KV-cache TTL tweak. I can spike the shim but need a staging GPU pool.
Jamal (Infra): I can reserve 2x A10g in staging for 72h. Tell me expected peak GPU mem and disk.
Priya (Runtime): Peak ~18GB GPU memory, short-lived disk for image decode only, then purge. Batch shape: batch=6, tokens~400, image ~1.2MB.
Elena (Security): Images could have PII. Required: no persistent storage, EXIF strip, signed upload URLs (short TTL). I need 48h for a threat review; if delayed, we enforce mitigations.
Tomas (Customer Success): ACME ok with staged beta (500 users) and signed DPA. They want rollback criteria and an acceptance rubric.
Noah (Eng): Rollout plan: feature flag -> canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Need gateway kill-switch and runtime fast-fail for oversized images.
Priya (Runtime): I'll add fast-fail (reject >2MB) + cache bypass toggle. ETA 36h for implementation and unit tests.
Maya (Product): Acceptance targets from ACME: p95 text <700ms, p95 multimodal <1.2s, quality F1 >=0.8. Also opt-out for image processing.
observability-bot: Please add telemetry: trace_id, p50/p95/p99 latencies, token_count, image_size, and cost metric.
Noah (Eng): I'll draft the API spec (POST /v1/summary {text, images:[url]}) and add e2e tests with image fixtures.
Jamal (Infra): Provision command I'll run tonight:
```
terraform apply -var='env=staging' -var='pool=acme-image-beta' -auto-approve
```
I'll also create an internal-only subdomain and mTLS cert.
Elena (Security): Interim mitigations if review misses 48h: 1) upload TTL=30s, 2) limited SSO group access, 3) no analytics export. I'll post checklist by EOD.
Maya (Product): Action owners recap:
- Elena: threat checklist + confirmation  EOD (security)
- Jamal: staging GPU pool + mTLS  tonight (infra)
- Priya: tokenization shim + fast-fail + tests  36h (runtime)
- Noah: API contract + e2e fixtures  48h (eng)
- Tomas: ACME beta window + acceptance rubric  today (CS)
Maya (Product): If any blocker surfaces, propose a 15m ad-hoc standup. :rocket:
